name: train_spec_riven
description: Dispatch marker for the Riven specialist (riftlab.yml, request=lab/specs/train_spec_riven.json, chain=N iterations). Since 10 Nov (lab/learn/TRAINING_KNOWLEDGE.md) it trains continuously: one candidate per iteration from 1600 self-play games (40% Riven mirror on any of its lists, the rest against loop.SPECIALISTS['riven']['train'] by their share of Riven's real games), adopted unless clearly worse than the net it replaces (mirror >= 45%, held-out panel diff >= -3 points); progress is read on the frozen anchor nets and the held-out 'measure' opponents. The adopted net travels in the Actions cache (ladder head_net) and is committed as current_net every 12 iterations. Ladder: lab/learn/specialists/riven/ladder.json; nets lab/learn/nets/spec_riven_*.
note: 6 Nov 22:40: Jeremy expects Riven to be nerfed; it keeps training on 4 of the 20 runners (Orianna 8, Mordekaiser 8). 480 self-play games at 200 simulations so an iteration stays a few hours on 4 runners. 10 Nov (Jeremy): Riven first, alone on the 20 runners; Volibear and Mordekaiser paused. 10 Nov 15:15 UTC, after 12 baseline iterations (91-102): step 3 on (a full 500-simulation search on a quarter of the moves, 80 simulations on the rest, moves sampled from the visits during the first 4 turns); the panel guard goes from -3 to -8 points (at 192 games a side, -3 refused about a quarter of the candidates that were as good as the net in place). 13 Nov 18:00 UTC (Jeremy: 'lance des simu cette nuit'): resumes from spec_riven_120_v0 for the post-ban question; 60% of the self-play pairs play variations of the post-ban starting lists (loop.SPECIALISTS['riven']['vary']), a net is committed every 6 iterations so the post-ban search can confirm with it (lab/OPTIMISER_KNOWLEDGE.md, section 6). 13 Nov 22:40 UTC (Jeremy: 'entraînement sur Voli, Morde, Riven et Evelynn après ban', away for the weekend): post-ban track (loop._POSTBAN_TRACKS: lists and opponents without the banned cards, continuous mode, a net committed every 6 iterations), 5 of the 20 runners.
